text:
Because the order includes a live plant and was placed after 12 noon on Wednesday, it will ship the following Monday. The ceramic pot is a non-living item, but mixed orders ship together on a plant day, so both items go out together on that Monday.

Once it ships, you'll get a tracking email. Delivery then takes 2-3 business days (Zone 1) to 5-8 business days (Zone 3) with Standard shipping, depending on your distance from our nearest greenhouse. Express is available in Zones 1 and 2 (next business day and 2 business days, respectively). If a weather hold applies, live plants can be held up to 7 days, and we'll email you.

You can also still change or cancel the order free from "My Orders" within 2 hours of placing it. Since it's past that window, support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.
